# RAPID Share

| Operation | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`dartwic-share/connect`](Operations/dartwic-share-connect.md) | Connects the engine to a remote RAPID Share node. |
| [`dartwic-share/disconnect`](Operations/dartwic-share-disconnect.md) | Disconnects a RAPID Share node. |
| [`dartwic-share/get-runtime-metadata`](Operations/dartwic-share-get-runtime-metadata.md) | Returns runtime metadata. |
| [`dartwic-share/list`](Operations/dartwic-share-list.md) | Lists configured and connected RAPID Share nodes. |
| [`dartwic-share/rapid/get-channel`](Operations/dartwic-share-rapid-get-channel.md) | Returns a channel from a remote RAPID runtime. |
| [`dartwic-share/rapid/list-channels`](Operations/dartwic-share-rapid-list-channels.md) | Lists channels exposed by a remote RAPID runtime. |
| [`dartwic-share/rapid/list-tasks`](Operations/dartwic-share-rapid-list-tasks.md) | Lists tasks exposed by a remote RAPID runtime. |
| [`dartwic-share/rapid/upsert-channel-path`](Operations/dartwic-share-rapid-upsert-channel-path.md) | Creates or updates a channel path on a remote RAPID runtime. |
| [`dartwic-share/reconnect-remembered`](Operations/dartwic-share-reconnect-remembered.md) | Reconnects a previously remembered RAPID Share node. |
